key_insight: PagedWeight dynamically quantizes MoE expert weights at runtime to balance model precision with KV-cache growth, improving the memory–quality tradeoff during LLM serving.
engineering_relevance: It is directly relevant for deploying MoE LLMs in memory-constrained serving systems where GPU memory, throughput, and latency must be jointly optimized.
method: Monitors serving-time memory pressure and adjusts expert-weight quantization dynamically.
Trades off expert precision against KV-cache size to fit within GPU memory budgets.
Targets MoE inference scenarios with an explicit quality-memory-throughput balance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports FP16-equivalent accuracy with up to 72.0% GPU memory savings and 1.94× throughput improvement, plus up to 39.3% better quality than quantization baselines at similar memory budgets.
watch_item: Runtime quantization and scheduling add system complexity, so stability and overhead need careful validation in real serving pipelines.
paper_title: PagedWeight: Efficient MoE LLM Serving with Dynamic Quality-Aware Weight Quantization
